definitions.explanation: Plants cultivated for food or other uses.

examples.japanese: {作物|さくもつ}を{育|そだ}てる。
{今年|ことし}は{天候|てんこう}に{恵|めぐ}まれ、{作物|さくもつ}の{収穫|しゅうかく}が{例年|れいねん}より{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: This year we were blessed with good weather, and the crop harvest was larger than usual.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{米|こめ}や{麦|むぎ}などの{作物|さくもつ}を{中心|ちゅうしん}に{農業|のうぎょう}が{営|いとな}まれている。
examples.english: In this area, farming is centered on crops such as rice and wheat.

notes:
{作物|さくもつ} refers to plants cultivated by humans for food, fiber, or other uses. It covers all types of crops including grains, vegetables, and fruits.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {農作物|のうさくもつ}: agricultural products/crops
- {作物|さくもつ}{栽培|さいばい}: crop cultivation
- {主要|しゅよう}{作物|さくもつ}: main/staple crops
- {畑作物|はたさくもつ}: dry-field crops (as opposed to rice paddy crops)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {作物|さくもつ}を{育|そだ}てる: to grow crops
- {作物|さくもつ}が{実|みの}る: the crops bear fruit
- {作物|さくもつ}を{収穫|しゅうかく}する: to harvest crops
- {作物|さくもつ}が{被害|ひがい}を{受|う}ける: crops suffer damage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {穀物|こくもつ}: grains specifically (rice, wheat, corn)
- {農産物|のうさんぶつ}: agricultural products (broader, includes processed goods)
- {野菜|やさい}: vegetables (one type of crop)
